description: This file defines the PersistableProductOption class, which extends ProductOptionEntity and implements Serializable. It manages a list of ProductOptionDescription objects and provides getter and setter methods for this list.

classes.name: PersistableProductOption
classes.description: A Java class representing a product option that is persistable, extending ProductOptionEntity and serializable, with descriptions.

methods.name: setDescriptions
methods.description: Sets the list of product option descriptions.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Returns the list of product option descriptions.
